summary: The enclosure is visually coherent and includes the principal chassis, ventilation, mounting, rear-layer, PSU, control, and foot structures. Exact component-envelope fits, cable bend clearances, and hidden electrical routing are not established by the available CAD views, so those interface checks remain not verified.

checks.description: The assembly reads as a complete, proportionate small-form-factor enclosure; the frame, panels, internal supports, control, and feet form a coherent structure with no obvious floating part or gross visible collision.

evidence.description: The isometric overview visibly shows the principal enclosure structures assembled into one coherent chassis.

checks.description: A motherboard tray and mounting features are visible, but no standard 170 x 170 mm motherboard reference body or dimensioned mounting-pattern evidence is shown, and rear-I/O accessibility cannot be conclusively established.

evidence.description: The view shows an internal tray, but does not visually prove the exact Mini-ITX footprint, hole pattern, or installed rear-I/O access.

checks.description: The vented side and interior depth are visible, but the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope is not represented, so cooler fit and preserved intake clearance cannot be directly verified.

evidence.description: The front projection shows enclosure depth and side ventilation, but no cooler envelope against which clearance can be judged.

checks.description: A dedicated rear GPU mount, bracket region, and riser guide are visible, but the approved GPU envelope, connector body, and power-cable bend volume are absent; complete fit is therefore not established.

evidence.description: The image visibly supports the presence of GPU mounting structure, but not clearance to an actual approved GPU and its cables.

checks.description: The rear upper PSU cradle and spatial offset from the GPU region are visible, but an exact 160 x 80 x 40 mm PSU reference, connector/cable bend volumes, and airflow validation are not shown.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows a distinct upper rear cradle, but does not directly prove exact PSU-envelope fit or operational cable and airflow clearances.

checks.description: The button is visibly accessible from the exterior front face, but the required hidden internal path to the motherboard header is not visible in the available view.

evidence.description: The front view directly shows the externally accessible circular power button; it cannot show or prove the internal header-wire route.

checks.description: The focused rear views show the motherboard spine/tray separated from a dedicated GPU shelf and rear bracket, with an identifiable guide forming a clear back-to-back layered layout.

evidence.description: The rear isometric view visibly distinguishes the motherboard tray, GPU mounting layer, rear bracket region, and cable/riser guide.

checks.description: The compact PSU cradle is visibly located in the upper rear zone above and offset from the GPU mount, with separate retention structure and adjacent routing features.

evidence.description: The focused rear isometric view clearly shows the upper PSU cradle arranged above the lower GPU mounting region rather than overlapping it.

checks.description: The model visibly reads as a developed ITX enclosure rather than a simple envelope: it includes a chassis frame, two ventilated side panels, front button, internal tray, GPU and PSU structures, and feet.

evidence.description: The isometric view visibly presents the complete enclosure vocabulary, including exterior panels and purposeful internal mounting structures.

checks.description: Both side faces visibly provide extensive direct perforated intake area; the front control and front/rear access regions are discernible in the orthographic views.

evidence.description: The left elevation directly shows broad perforated intake coverage on the CPU-side panel.
The right elevation directly shows broad perforated intake coverage on the GPU/PSU-side panel.
The front view shows the externally reachable power control and recognizable maintenance-facing structure.

checks.description: The focused views visibly show distinct motherboard, GPU, and PSU zones without gross overlap. Supporting bounding-box facts give the chassis as 120 x 200 x 205 mm, corresponding to 4.92 L, while GPU and PSU mounting extents occupy separate lower and upper rear regions.

evidence.description: The focused isometric image visibly shows the internal mount regions arranged as distinct volumes inside the complete chassis rather than superimposed envelopes.
The right-side view visibly supports vertical separation of the lower GPU region and upper compact-PSU region within the enclosure.
